text: What a frightful event! I tremble! What infatuation! Personally I am indifferent, but I really tremble for my country! I may be mistaken, though' I cannot but that the Commons House upon a dissolution, which must be had, will be a mass of Radicalism, & then God knows what may happen... Nebule! What infatuatiou!
